notes.before: before-* runs: the same build with ?inflight=0 (no frame cap) = the behaviour before this change; the first before-30Hz run on the unchanged code gave Event Timing p50 56 / p95 64 ms and the HUD estimate 86.6 ms
notes.hog: HOG_MS=40: a separate Chrome process keeps the GPU busy with ~40 ms compute dispatches, 2 in flight, like a DaVinci render (positive control for the GPU queue)
notes.eventToScreenEst: first drawn frame with the sample, presented on the first vsync >= 1 period after its rAF and after GPU done, + 1 period of desktop composition and scan-out
notes.eventToPresentation: Chrome Event Timing (8 ms steps): the next compositor frame; when the canvas frame is held it presents the old picture, so it under-reads with the cap under load
notes.display: 3840x2160 @ 30 Hz over HDMI (Samsung U28D590), RTX 4090; probe window 1280x800 dpr 1

model.source: tools/bench/src/step-response.ts (Node, real Sim, 1.5 s hover then a stick step; ms after the step)
model.bfReference: BF 4.5 self-level loop from formulas around a 15 ms rate lag: 10/50/90 % at 36/100/191 ms; without angle feed-forward 39/146/433; level strength 100: 26/69/123
